'''Gibberous Crumb''' was a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was raised by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], but was eventually abandoned by his master and entered the care of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Crumb was present aboard a [[Riboga's Barge|sail barge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], when Nirama met with some [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] there.

==Biography==
[[File:Crumb_btm.png|thumb|left|250px|Gibberous Crumb was the cousin of Salacious Crumb (pictured).]]
Gibberous Crumb was a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] born during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was the cousin of [[Salacious B. Crumb/Legends|Salacious B. Crumb]], a monkey-lizard who would later become the jester of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Gibberous was raised by a Hutt, but was abandoned by his master and entered the care of the [[Oblee]] crime lord [[Nirama]], whose [[Organization]] controlled crime in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Nirama disliked Crumb, as he considered the monkey-lizard to be an annoyance.<ref name="OA" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Open Aarms]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Crumb was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], when Nirama met with a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] whom the Oblee wanted to investigate a [[S-Ipsus|research facility]] in the floating [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ipsus]]. The meeting took place in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tolea Biqua]], aboard ''[[Riboga's Barge]]'', a [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] that was used as a [[Casino/Legends|casino]]. During the meeting, Crumb stayed in the back room of the barge and climbed onto the side of a [[Fish/Legends|fish]] tank. He gazed at the amphibious creatures inside the tank and cackled every few [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="OA" />

==Personality and traits==
Crumb had gangly [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and legs and a tuft of [[Color/Legends|orange]]-colored [[Hair/Legends|hair]] on the top of his head. He was less intelligent than his cousin Salacious and was also loud and obnoxious. He was not a good fighter and was loyal to no one. Crumb also liked to eat rotting meat.<ref name="OA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|An annoyance. When you're obnoxious enough that a Hutt leaves you behind&hellip; Steer clear of him.|Nirama's reply, if the player characters ask him what Crumb is|<ref name="OA" />}}
Gibberous Crumb was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and made his only appearance in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Open Aarms]]'', a [[2003]] scenario in the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. The scenario was published by [[RPGA]] as a supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]s' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="OA" />

In ''Open Aarms'', the players [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the freelance agents that meet Nirama on ''Riboga's Barge'' and it is possible for the players to ask Nirama about Crumb. If any of the player characters endeavor to be nice to Crumb, Nirama gives Crumb to the player as a gift. If a player receives Crumb, every time they play with other people in a ''Living Force'' event, every participating player in the group must make a charisma check,<ref name="OA" /> a means of gaining scores for the strengths of personality of all player characters.<ref name="RGCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Crumb then falls in love with the player who has the highest score, and that person becomes his new owner. If another player in the group owns a Kowakian monkey-lizard, then at the start of an event, Crumb and the other monkey-lizard rush off to have fun together. At the end of the event, Crumb's owner would then roll a die to determine whether or not Crumb returns.<ref name="OA" />
